rounds.notes:
## Unfortunately I haven't had that much time to get to round notes yet, but most of the info you'll need is in item notes. Most of these are from the pre-S17 build, so they might be outdated or not make sense. 

## I also haven't gotten onto the  [Thrill of Battle](item_80ed7f65-e015-4dbb-ada0-fb8fa9b9b086) /  [Reckoner’s Roar](item_efe615c6-8b32-4847-9d8f-4f55adaeba52) build yet, but basically it revolves around taking  [Reckoner’s Roar](item_efe615c6-8b32-4847-9d8f-4f55adaeba52) round 3 with booming voice then going for AP and sustain.

**Round 1** is all about doing JQ things. Get up in their faces and keep them bleeding. If your team pushes with you it will be hard to get flanked and you might finish with anywhere from 1k healing to 3k on a really good first round. (You get half of the amount of healing you gave as money, so right now it's a small amount, but it will improve throughout the game.

If all goes well, you should be receiving a lot more attention from your supports as you heal the rest of your team.

It's important to note that you can't take a step back with this build until much later rounds. Play as aggressively as you would usually with JQ, and make sure abilities are constantly flying to keep wounds up and you right in their face's.

round_upgrades.notes:
An item I personally get lots of value out of due to its snowball potential. 
If you don't feel the composition has many weak points, take another $1500 item, like Siphon Gloves or the new Ballistic Buffer over this one.

Benefits knife and carnage which should be used the second they come up, so expect a lot of value from this item.

JQ Stadium tip:
Its important to note that your wounds also scale with AP, so this items increase the effectiveness of Thrill of Battle and your own healing. Numbers of the healing benefits are listed in round description.

JQ Stadium tip 2:
Even though wounds scale with AP, they do not trigger items like Cybervenom, however Reckoner's Roar wounds DO trigger effects like Cybervenom.

If you play like me and panic melee an enemy as soon as they come into range, then the sustain this item gives might be alright.

This issue is that melee dps is so much lower than shooting them with your gun, that playing like this will hinder your effectiveness greatly.

The healing on this item might be good with squishies, but you will get a lot more if you focus on keeping your wounds active rather than refreshing them.

Overall I think this item is just a bit of a trap for newer players.

The only new common item added this season, but a welcome addition. 

Unlike other $1000 survival commons, this one seems to have some viability as a tank. 
If you are getting pestered by an Ash or Soldier, this item can be good for preventing being bursted down.

But the real use of it is as an escape tool. Because you are staying close to enemies constantly as JQ, the cooldown of this item should easily refresh. Then, when things start getting hairy, you can use the bonus health to regroup.

A niche item for JQ due to her already great sustain, but you will be getting value out of it from active use of abilities.

JQ Stadium tip:
Ability lifesteal does not work with wound damage, even though wounds scale with AP.

The healing you get from it is still good, but AP should always be prioritised first.

A very flexible pick. If you have another $1000 item you prefer, feel free to take it over this one. 

Shady Spectacles is a good substitute due to the high ability uptime and usage with Junker Queen, but most of you survivability will be coming from wound healing.

A very passive power which benefits a tightly-knit team greatly. 

The healing buffs from S18 are insane, and if teammates stick near to you while you push up, you will be able to win so many team fights.

There isn't really any flexibility on this choice, unless you want to follow another build.

Check round details for stats of healing this power gives.

## *(*These round notes are outdated)*

With round 2 you have a lot of flexibility on how you want to tackle things. If you feel like you aren't exactly anchoring your team but you are playing well enough to do so,  [Undying Loyalty](item_d0278c35-8006-4c8d-8f02-4fd0217fd3e2) is most likely the way to go. It's a huge supportive boost for your whole team as long as you are staying healthy enough to get value from the item. 

The overhealth bonus will block more ultimates and save more teammates when supports are busy, especially by round 3 where you can hopefully afford  [Booming Voice](item_d751b552-4c3f-49d6-966b-611096fd2259) to give a near global boost to your team.

Power Playbook is the best item to fall back onto if you have any spare cash, so always prioritise this item in that case.

AP, shout going through walls and extra range for it make it fantastic in ANY JQ build, but particularly this one.

A nice alternative if you are strapped for cash after a rough or short first round, however it won't provide much support for your team.

Bigger magnet is so nice. 10% AP is already good, but the extra pull strength turns "pulling the tank away from their healers" to "teleporting the tank into the middle of your team". 

If you manage to catch any squishies with your knife, they'll only realise whats going on after they are turned into swiss cheese.

The buffs to this item are also great, rewarding those extremely tough and risky attempts to snipe moths out of the sky.

Definitely my favourite item for JQ regardless of the build.

This is only recommended if you want the shorter cooldowns for your knife and carnage for Ironclad Exhaust Points or Lumerico Fusion Drive.

Such a good value item. After the buff which gave it +10 Health, its basically a "3-green-items-for-just-1-slot" kind of deal.

You can keep coming back to this with any leftover money throughout the game.

A great sustain item not limited by anti-heal, which can really shut down JQ. 

The impact this item has will become less noticeable the later into the game you hold onto it, but for the price it is one of JQ's best pickups.

rounds.notes:
If things are going well, by round 3 you should be able to afford  [Booming Voice](item_d751b552-4c3f-49d6-966b-611096fd2259) and  [Undying Loyalty](item_d0278c35-8006-4c8d-8f02-4fd0217fd3e2) . These are the 2 core items of this build, but if you aren't able to afford both of these, take  [Reckoner’s Roar](item_efe615c6-8b32-4847-9d8f-4f55adaeba52) over  [Let’s Go Win](item_80df18f3-8530-4e55-8ea3-9ac7a3f12508) and switch to the  [Thrill of Battle](item_80ed7f65-e015-4dbb-ada0-fb8fa9b9b086) build. 

Now, with  [Booming Voice](item_d751b552-4c3f-49d6-966b-611096fd2259) and  [Let’s Go Win](item_80df18f3-8530-4e55-8ea3-9ac7a3f12508) you can spam your shouts as soon as they come up and support your whole team without a worry in the world. Keep pressure up, and remember to spend any extra cash on AP items due to their scaling with all your wounds, which mean more healing.

## Ignore these round notes, just some things I had in build notes but are unfinished. I am working on a JQ stadium guide in the backround which goes over tips and item choices, but I am prioritising this build at the minute.


I have made a guide explaining everything a new player would need to know on Junker Queen in stadium, which has some important tips about bleed and how that will affect functionality here. I will go to the liberty of explaining stats for healing used in this build, but for everything else and more I recommend having a quick look over the guide, because I learnt *a lot* about JQ while making it. Its linked here -- 


Below is what I had predicted before the patch, which all came true and more :(

There is talking about  [Thrill of Battle](item_80ed7f65-e015-4dbb-ada0-fb8fa9b9b086) getting buffed, which is not a good thing and is actually quite scary.
I think Thrill of Battle is a very good perk as it is that provides great healing for the team, and if they buff how much healing it gives or the range to much it will be OP and overused. 
And that means there will be more of a spotlight on JQ and just how good she is in stadium, and she will get nerfed, not just reverted.

Anyways this was made before that suspected buff so take it as you will.

round_upgrades.notes: Now it will be able to extend the wounds of Reckoner's Roar, which is a guaranteed hit with the press of a button. Great for battlecry playstyle.
Some sustain and a great solo clutch power, stalling to give your team so leeway to get back to the point in overtime.

Now it's the last round, Bow Down is actually really good. 

This round will almost certainly be determined by a significant team fight, and Bow Down might just give the edge to determine the result for that fight. 

A very good choice for Round 7 and Round 7 only.
A really good power for Lumerico, Ironclad or Scav, since it gives knife basically constant uptime if you aim it right.

If you are struggling to find the perfect moment to use your ults, this item gives you a ton of stats and rewards you for not using it. 

Just don't fall into a lull of never using your ult because you want the stats. This item is more just here to help you use it at the perfect moment.

JQ Stadium tip:
Don't always aim to hit EVERYONE with your ult. Guaranteeing a few kills is much more valuable than hitting the whole enemy team, especially with all the items that still work while anti-healed.
The overhealth is basically worthless, but the stats are really nice. Just a shame cooldown reduction doesn't work with shouts.

Give your shout a slowing  effect with Reckoner's, even more encouraging the battlecry playstyle. Good stats too.
